key_note: Rocky v1.9 stabilizes selectable pets, per-pet memory, sleep listening, screen awareness, and the Gemini Live voice loop.
whats_new: Added selectable desktop pets with separate animations, voices, names, base prompts, and personality settings
Kept user profile memory shared while isolating recent chat and long-term memories per character
Added memory management controls for editing profile memory, long-term memories, and recent context
Added configurable sleep listening so the pet can stay silent while asleep and wake only for clear user requests
Fixed sleep-state loops, stale wake prompts, and weather/news requests getting stuck after waking
Improved pet switching so the visible character updates immediately and the Gemini Live session refreshes safely
Removed the unstable VAD experiment and restored the simpler documented 1024-frame Gemini Live audio stream
Improved screen sharing and optional quiet screen awareness with higher-quality screen frames
Made voice/session recovery more resilient when Gemini or the network is slow
